exposure: Bacterial pathogens (Staphylococcus aureus, E. coli, Staphylococcus spp)
outcome: Surgical site infection (SSI) after cesarean delivery
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean section at M.L.B. Medical College, Jhansi during 2023.
finding: The incidence rate of surgical site infection among cesarean sections was 7.74%, with BMI, comorbidity, emergency caesarian delivery, duration of membrane rupture, and blood loss during surgery being significantly associated risk factors, and *Staphylococcus aureus* being the most common bacterial pathogen.
